## Summary
Greenfield build of **StockRoom**: a NestJS 11 + Prisma 6 (Postgres) API with JWT auth and role-based guards, plus an Angular 19 standalone SPA, served together from one multi-stage Docker image.

## Scope

### Files to create

**Repo root**
- `package.json` — npm workspaces (`backend`, `frontend`), root scripts `dev`, `build`, `test`, `e2e`
- `Dockerfile` — multi-stage: build Angular → build Nest → runtime serves both
- `.dockerignore`, `.gitignore`, `docker-compose.yml` (Postgres 16 + app for local dev)
- `.env.example` — `DATABASE_URL`, `JWT_SECRET`, `JWT_EXPIRES_IN`, `PORT`
- `README.md` — replace stub with run/seed/deploy instructions

**Backend — `backend/`**
- `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `nest-cli.json`, `.eslintrc.cjs`
- `prisma/schema.prisma` — `User`, `Item`, `Location`, `StockLevel`, `Movement`, `Role`/`MovementType` enums
- `prisma/seed.ts` — 2 users, 3 locations, 8 items, opening stock levels
- `src/main.ts` — global `ValidationPipe({whitelist, transform})`, `/api` global prefix (excluding static), `PORT` bind `0.0.0.0`
- `src/app.module.ts` — wires modules, `ServeStaticModule`, `APP_GUARD` × 2
- `src/prisma/prisma.module.ts`, `src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`
- `src/auth/` — `auth.module.ts`, `auth.controller.ts`, `auth.service.ts`, `jwt.strategy.ts`, `jwt-auth.guard.ts`, `roles.guard.ts`, `decorators/public.decorator.ts`, `decorators/roles.decorator.ts`, `decorators/current-user.decorator.ts`, `dto/login.dto.ts`, `dto/signup.dto.ts`
- `src/items/` — `items.module.ts`, `items.controller.ts`, `items.service.ts`, `dto/create-item.dto.ts`, `dto/update-item.dto.ts`
- `src/locations/` — `locations.module.ts`, `locations.controller.ts`, `locations.service.ts`, `dto/create-location.dto.ts`, `dto/update-location.dto.ts`
- `src/movements/` — `movements.module.ts`, `movements.controller.ts`, `movements.service.ts`, `dto/create-movement.dto.ts`, `dto/query-movements.dto.ts`
- `src/reports/` — `reports.module.ts`, `reports.controller.ts`, `reports.service.ts`
- `src/health/health.controller.ts`, `src/health/health.module.ts`
- `test/*.e2e-spec.ts` — one file per spec Requirement

**Frontend — `frontend/`**
- `package.json`, `angular.json`, `tsconfig*.json`, `src/index.html` (`<title>StockRoom</title>`), `src/main.ts`, `src/styles.scss`
- `src/app/app.config.ts` — `provideRouter(routes, withComponentInputBinding())`, `provideHttpClient(withInterceptors([authInterceptor]))`
- `src/app/app.component.ts|html` — shell, brand text **StockRoom**, role-aware nav, logout
- `src/app/core/` — `auth.service.ts`, `auth.interceptor.ts`, `auth.guard.ts`, `role.guard.ts`, `api.service.ts`, `models.ts`
- `src/app/routes.ts` — route table (below)
- `src/app/features/auth/` — `login.component`, `signup.component`
- `src/app/features/items/` — `item-list`, `item-detail`, `item-form`
- `src/app/features/locations/` — `location-list`, `location-form`
- `src/app/features/movements/` — `movement-form`, `movement-log`

- `src/app/shared/confirm-dialog.component.ts`

### Files to modify
- `README.md` — currently the one-line stub `# inventory-10`
- `.github/workflows/colossus-deploy.yml` — **no change**; managed by Colossus, already triggers the internal pipeline

### Dependencies
- Backend: `@nestjs/{common,core,platform-express,config,jwt,passport,serve-static}`, `passport`, `passport-jwt`, `@prisma/client`, `prisma`, `bcryptjs`, `class-validator`, `class-transformer`; dev: `jest`, `supertest`, `ts-node`, `typescript`
- Frontend: `@angular/{core,common,router,forms,platform-browser}` v19, `rxjs`, `zone.js`
- Infra: Postgres 16, Node 22 (Alpine base images)

### Integrations
None — the spec declares no third-party services.

### Assumptions
- **Monorepo, single deployed container.** NestJS serves the Angular bundle; there is no separate frontend service. Chosen because the smoke oracle loads the app root and must find "StockRoom" there.
- **`manager` is the admin role.** First signup → `manager`; all later signups → `clerk`. Public routes: `/login`, `/signup`, `/api/health`, `/api/health/deep`.
- **JWT in `localStorage`**, `Authorization: Bearer`, 12 h expiry — the spec's stated auth mechanism and the standard Angular/Nest pairing.
- **Low-stock predicate is `SUM(qty) <= reorderAt`**, derived from the spec's own boundary scenario.
- **Seeded opening stock**: items are seeded with non-zero balances across the 3 locations so the low-stock report and audit log are non-empty on first load; at least one item is seeded at/below its threshold.
- **Locations**: `Zone A`, `Zone B`, `Zone C` (names matching the spec's scenarios), each with a `zone` field.
- **Deletes are blocked, not cascaded**, when an item/location has non-zero stock or referencing movements (409) — preserves audit integrity.
- **Movement list is paginated** (`page`, `pageSize`, default 25) and ordered `createdAt DESC`.
- Money/units are integers; `qty` is a positive `Int`.

## Implementation Plan

### Step 1: Workspace + deployment chain
**Files:** `package.json`, `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`, `.dockerignore`, `.env.example`
**Change:** npm workspaces over `backend`/`frontend`. Dockerfile stages:
1. `web`: `npm ci` in `frontend`, `npx ng build --configuration production` → output at `frontend/dist/stockroom/browser`
2. `api`: `npm ci` in `backend`, `npx prisma generate`, `nest build` → `backend/dist`
3. runtime (`node:22-alpine`): copy `backend/dist`, `backend/node_modules`, `backend/prisma`, and **`COPY --from=web /app/frontend/dist/stockroom/browser ./client`**. `CMD` runs `npx prisma migrate deploy && node dist/prisma/seed.js && node dist/main.js`. Expose `PORT` (default 3000).
The `./client` path is the single source of truth — `ServeStaticModule` in Step 4 must point at exactly this directory.

### Step 2: Prisma schema + seed
**Files:** `backend/prisma/schema.prisma`, `backend/prisma/seed.ts`
**Change:**
```prisma
enum Role { clerk manager }
enum MovementType { IN OUT TRANSFER }
model User      { id String @id @default(cuid()) email String @unique passwordHash String role Role @default(clerk) createdAt DateTime @default(now()) movements Movement[] }
model Item      { id String @id @default(cuid()) sku String @unique name String description String? unit String reorderAt Int @default(0) stockLevels StockLevel[] movements Movement[] }
model Location  { id String @id @default(cuid()) name String @unique zone String stockLevels StockLevel[] }
model StockLevel{ id String @id @default(cuid()) itemId String locationId String qty Int @default(0) item Item @relation(...) location Location @relation(...) @@unique([itemId, locationId]) }
model Movement  { id String @id @default(cuid()) type MovementType itemId String fromLocId String? toLocId String? qty Int note String? userId String createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @@index([itemId, createdAt]) @@index([createdAt]) }
```
`@@unique([itemId, locationId])` makes balance upserts safe. Seed is idempotent (`upsert` by `email`/`sku`/`name`), hashes `Demo1234!` with bcrypt cost 10, and creates `StockLevel` rows directly (no Movement rows) plus a handful of historical `Movement` rows so the audit log has content.

### Step 3: Prisma service
**File:** `backend/src/prisma/prisma.service.ts`
**Change:** `PrismaClient` subclass with `onModuleInit` → `$connect()`, `enableShutdownHooks`. Exported by a `@Global()` module.

### Step 4: App module, static serving, global guards
**File:** `backend/src/app.module.ts`, `backend/src/main.ts`
**Change:** `ConfigModule.forRoot({isGlobal:true})`; `ServeStaticModule.forRoot({ rootPath: join(__dirname, '..', 'client'), exclude: ['/api/{*splat}'] })` so the SPA deep-links (`/items/abc`) fall back to `index.html` while `/api/*` reaches controllers. In `main.ts`: `app.setGlobalPrefix('api', { exclude: [] })` applied before static, global `ValidationPipe`. Register `APP_GUARD` for `JwtAuthGuard` then `RolesGuard` — auth is deny-by-default; opt out with `@Public()`.

### Step 5: Auth module
**Files:** `backend/src/auth/*`
**Change:**
- `POST /api/auth/signup` (`@Public`) — validates email + password (min 8); inside a transaction, counts users: `count === 0 → manager`, else `clerk`; unique-email violation → 409.
- `POST /api/auth/login` (`@Public`) — bcrypt compare, returns `{ accessToken, user: {id, email, role} }`; failure → 401 with a generic message.
- `GET /api/auth/me` — returns current user; `POST /api/auth/logout` — 204 (client discards token).
- `JwtStrategy` validates `sub`/`email`/`role`, re-loads the user, attaches to `req.user`.
- `RolesGuard` reads `@Roles(Role.manager)` metadata; missing role → **403**, missing/invalid token → **401** (satisfies the two rejection scenarios).

### Step 6: Items module
**Files:** `backend/src/items/*`
**Change:**
- `GET /api/items` (any authenticated) — returns each item with `totalQty` computed by including `stockLevels` and summing, plus `lowStock: totalQty <= reorderAt`. Supports `?q=` (sku/name contains, insensitive).
- `GET /api/items/:id` — item plus `levels: [{locationId, locationName, zone, qty}]` and `totalQty`; the breakdown sums to `totalQty` by construction.
- `POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` — `@Roles(manager)`. `CreateItemDto`: `sku` (non-empty, trimmed), `name`, `description?`, `unit`, `reorderAt` (`@IsInt @Min(0)`). Duplicate SKU → catch Prisma `P2002` → **409 with a validation message**, guaranteeing no second row. `DELETE` → 409 if any `StockLevel.qty > 0` or movements exist.

### Step 7: Locations module
**Files:** `backend/src/locations/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/locations` for any authenticated user (needed to populate the movement form's selects). `POST`/`PATCH`/`DELETE` `@Roles(manager)`; `name` unique → `P2002` → 409. Delete blocked when stock is non-zero.

### Step 8: Movements module — the transactional core
**Files:** `backend/src/movements/*`
**Change:**
`CreateMovementDto`: `type` (`@IsEnum`), `itemId`, `fromLocId?`, `toLocId?`, `qty` (`@IsInt @Min(1)`), `note?`. A custom class-level validator enforces: `IN` → `toLocId` required, `fromLocId` forbidden; `OUT` → `fromLocId` required, `toLocId` forbidden; `TRANSFER` → both required and `fromLocId !== toLocId`.

`create()` runs entirely inside `prisma.$transaction(async tx => {...}, { isolationLevel: 'Serializable' })`:
1. Verify item and referenced locations exist (404 otherwise).
2. For `OUT`/`TRANSFER`: read the `StockLevel` for `(itemId, fromLocId)`; if missing or `qty < dto.qty` → **throw `BadRequestException`, aborting the transaction so the stored balance is untouched**.
3. Apply deltas via `tx.stockLevel.upsert` on the `itemId_locationId` compound key — decrement source and/or increment destination (`increment`/`decrement`).
4. Write the `Movement` row with `userId` from the JWT and default `createdAt`.
Return the movement plus the affected balances. Wrap the call in a small retry (up to 3 attempts on Prisma `P2034` write-conflict) so concurrent writers serialize rather than fail.

`GET /api/movements` `@Roles(manager)` — filters `?itemId=`, `?type=`, `?from=`/`?to=` (ISO dates, `to` treated as end-of-day inclusive), `?page=`, `?pageSize=`; includes `user: {email, role}`, `item: {sku, name}`, and resolved from/to location names; returns `{ data, total, page, pageSize }`.

### Step 9: Low-stock report
**Files:** `backend/src/reports/*`
**Change:** `GET /api/reports/low-stock` `@Roles(manager)` — aggregates `StockLevel` by `itemId`, joins `Item`, returns items where `COALESCE(SUM(qty),0) <= reorderAt`, ordered by shortfall descending. Items with no stock rows at all are included (total 0). Implemented with `$queryRaw` for a single round-trip, typed via a result interface.

### Step 10: Health endpoints
**File:** `backend/src/health/health.controller.ts`
**Change:** `@Public() GET /api/health` → `{status:'ok'}`; `@Public() GET /api/health/deep` → runs `SELECT 1` through Prisma, returns `{status, db}`, 503 on failure.

### Step 11: Angular shell, auth plumbing, routes
**Files:** `frontend/src/app/app.config.ts`, `app.component.*`, `core/*`, `routes.ts`
**Change:**
- `AuthService`: signals `token`, `user`, `isManager`; `login`/`signup` persist token to `localStorage` and hydrate `user` from `/api/auth/me` on bootstrap; `logout()` clears and navigates to `/login`.
- `authInterceptor` (functional): attaches `Authorization` when a token exists; on 401 clears state and redirects to `/login?returnUrl=…`.
- `authGuard` (`CanActivateFn`) on every non-public route; `managerGuard` additionally requires `role === 'manager'` and redirects clerks to `/items`.
- Shell renders the literal brand **StockRoom** in the header and in `index.html`'s `<title>` — the smoke marker. Nav hides manager-only links for clerks.

Route table — every navigable state addressable, each with `data.flow`:
| Path | Guard | `data.flow` |
|---|---|---|
| `/login` | public | `auth.login` |
| `/signup` | public | `auth.signup` |
| `/items?q=&low=` | auth | `items.list` |
| `/items/new` | manager | `items.create` |
| `/items/:id?tab=locations\|movements` | auth | `items.detail` |
| `/items/:id/edit` | manager | `items.edit` |
| `/locations` | auth | `locations.list` |
| `/locations/new`, `/locations/:id/edit` | manager | `locations.create` / `locations.edit` |
| `/movements/new?type=&itemId=&fromLocId=` | auth | `movements.create` |
| `/movements?itemId=&type=&from=&to=&page=` | manager | `movements.log` |
| `/reports/low-stock` | manager | `reports.lowStock` |
| any + `?modal=confirm-delete&id=` | — | deletion confirmation |
`''` redirects to `/items`; `**` redirects to `/items`.

### Step 12: Items & locations UI
**Files:** `frontend/src/app/features/items/*`, `features/locations/*`
**Change:** `item-list` — table of sku / name / unit / reorderAt / totalQty with a low-stock badge; search box two-way bound to `?q=` via `Router.navigate({queryParams, queryParamsHandling:'merge'})`. "New item"/"Edit"/"Delete" render only for managers. `item-detail` — header stats plus the per-location breakdown table with a footer total row, and a movements tab. `item-form` — reactive form, single component for create and edit driven by the presence of `:id`, surfaces the API's duplicate-SKU 409 as a field-level error on `sku`. Locations mirror this shape.

### Step 13: Movement entry + audit log + low-stock UI
**Files:** `frontend/src/app/features/movements/*`, `features/reports/low-stock.component.ts`
**Change:** `movement-form` — type selector (IN/OUT/TRANSFER) that conditionally shows source/destination selects mirroring the DTO rules, item typeahead, qty, note; prefills from query params; on 400 shows the server's insufficient-stock message inline without clearing the form. `movement-log` — filter bar (item, type, date range) bound to query params so a filtered view is shareable; columns: timestamp, user email, item, type, qty, from → to, note; paginated. `low-stock` — table of sku, name, on-hand, reorderAt, shortfall, with a "Record stock in" link deep-linking to `/movements/new?type=IN&itemId=…`.

### Step 14: Tests
**Files:** `backend/test/*.e2e-spec.ts`
**Change:** One suite per spec Requirement, each seeded against a disposable schema.

## Testing Strategy
- **Auth** — clerk and manager login succeed and return correct roles; unauthenticated call to `/api/items` → 401; clerk `POST /api/items` and `POST /api/locations` → 403.
- **Catalog** — manager creates an item and it appears in the list; duplicate `SKU-001` → 4xx validation error *and* a follow-up `GET` confirms exactly one row; clerk list response contains sku, name, unit, reorderAt, totalQty.
- **Movements** — IN 50 into Zone A on a zero item → balance 50 and a Movement row with user, qty, type, timestamp; OUT 20 → 30; TRANSFER 10 from A(30) to B(0) → A 20, B 10, total unchanged; OUT 10 against 5 on hand → 400 **and** a re-read still shows 5. A concurrency test fires two simultaneous OUT calls against a balance that only satisfies one, asserting exactly one succeeds and the balance never goes negative.
- **Low stock** — item at reorderAt 10 / 12 on hand, OUT 5, then assert it appears in `/api/reports/low-stock`; item at 40 on hand is absent.
- **Audit log** — entries expose user, item, type, qty, timestamp; filtering by `itemId` and by `from`/`to` returns only matching rows.
- **Health/smoke** — `/api/health/deep` returns ok against a live DB; a Playwright check loads `/` and asserts the visible text contains **StockRoom**, then walks login → items → record movement.
- **Deployment** — build the image locally, run against docker-compose Postgres, and confirm `/` serves the SPA and `/items/<id>` deep-link returns `index.html` rather than 404.

## Risks
- **Static-path mismatch.** If `ServeStaticModule.rootPath` and the Dockerfile `COPY` target drift, `/` 404s and the smoke oracle fails despite a healthy API. Both must reference `./client`; verify inside the built image before merging.
- **Global prefix vs. static.** `setGlobalPrefix('api')` combined with `ServeStaticModule` can shadow API routes if the exclude pattern is wrong — Nest 11 uses `{*splat}` syntax, not the Express 4 `*`.
- **Serializable retries.** Write conflicts surface as Prisma `P2034`; without the retry wrapper concurrent clerks get spurious 500s.
- **Seed on every boot.** The start command re-runs the seed; it must be strictly idempotent (upserts, no blind `create`) or restarts will crash on unique constraints or double the stock.
- **First-signup race.** Two simultaneous signups on an empty database could both read `count === 0`; the user-count check runs inside the same transaction as the insert to prevent two managers.
- **Demo credentials** are seeded with a known weak password — acceptable for the demo remit, unacceptable if real data lands.
